segments.text:
V. 14.
Will never thirſt—Will never (provided he continue to drink thereof) be miſerable, diſſatisfied, without Refreſhment. If ever that Thirſt returns, it will be the Fault of the Man, not the Water. But the water that I ſhall give him—The Spirit of Faith working by Love, Shall become in him—An inward, living Principle, a fountain—Not barely a Well, which is ſoon exhauſted, ſpringing up into everlaſting life—Which is a Confluence, or rather an Ocean of Streams ariſing from this Fountain.
